Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly stated that “the fascists remained in power in Albania until 1944,” despite the visible search results (e.g., Wikipedia and other sources) indicating the Albanian Fascist Party held power until 1943 (when Italy capitulated). This reflects a misinterpretation of sources and conflation of subsequent German occupation (1943–44) with the party’s period in power, leading to the wrong year.
